headline: PR 565 merged: the 'integrity' gate now runs on the self-hosted lane on main (21 executed steps, runner 'clay', success). Merging alone repairs nothing on the 227 remaining red pull requests: a pull_request run executes the workflow file carried by the PR head, not by main. Measured on PR 567: close/reopen after the merge still produced ubuntu-latest with 0 steps and failure; only branch-update against main flipped the same head to self-hosted, 21 steps, success.

repair.title: ci: restore Deep Integrity on current isolated self-hosted lane

propagation_law.claim: For pull_request events the workflow definition in effect is the one on the pull request head lineage, so a main-only fix does not retroactively change any open pull request verdict until that branch ingests main.
propagation_law.single_varied_factor: presence of main lineage in the pull request head; gate content, repository, runner pool and account state held constant

surface_state_after.remaining_action_required: branch-update each remaining head against main; no product change involved

banal_causes_excluded: measurement error: both trials read from the Actions jobs API on the same run family
caching: two runs minutes apart on the same repository and runner pool
model change: no model participates in gate execution
context length: not applicable to CI execution
chance: outcome is deterministic across the two lanes, 0 vs 21 executed steps
memory note instead of measurement: every number here comes from a live API read at 2026-08-13T03:05Z
significance: The billing artifact census of 2026-08-13T09:51+07:00 is now paired with a landed repair and a measured propagation law. Frank's red surface is not evidence of Frank defects; it is an instrument state that decays only as branches ingest main.
